findings.title: Recovery command can overwrite the only copy of another owning key
findings.description: The new-machine recovery example copies the old global credentials directly over `~/.bounded/credentials` without first checking for or backing up an existing key. `scp` overwrites the destination. If the newly generated key already owns any apps, replacing its only unbacked-up copy permanently orphans those apps under the ownership model documented earlier in this file.
findings.recommendation: Refuse to proceed when the destination exists. Copy the recovered key to a temporary mode-0600 file, verify its public address, back up the existing credentials under a distinct path, and only then atomically install the recovered key after explicit confirmation.

findings.title: Linked replacement key cannot satisfy the documented owner-address check
findings.description: Option B links the new machine's distinct wallet as an admin collaborator; linking does not replace the key or change its public address. The subsequent instruction nevertheless says that after A, B, or C, `bounded whoami` should match the original wallet owner recorded in `.bounded/app.json`. That is impossible for Option B and can make a successful recovery appear invalid.
findings.recommendation: For Option B, state that a different wallet address is expected and verify recovery with `bounded access --app-id <id> --json`, requiring the intended admin/deploy capabilities. Reserve owner-address equality for Options A and C.

findings.title: Account-switching guidance incorrectly says prior web sessions are replaced
findings.description: The page says there is one web session and that a second login replaces the first. The current CLI instead stores refreshable sessions per environment, platform app, and account under `~/.bounded/web-sessions/`; `~/.bounded/web-session.json` is only the most-recent compatibility copy. Previous accounts therefore remain usable and can be selected again by project context or `loginHint`. The stale guidance gives users and agents an incorrect credential inventory and cleanup model.
findings.recommendation: Document the scoped session directory and explain that account switching preserves earlier sessions. Direct users to the CLI logout operation when they intend to remove every persisted web credential.
